create_listcache: create a ListCache instance to store and sample training elements with optional token limiting
create_roundrobin_cache: create a RoundRobinCache with a fixed size that overwrites oldest elements when full
sample_batch_cache: sample a batch of n elements from a Cache and return padded sentence tensors
batch_sequences_cache: batch a list of torch sequences into a padded tensor with corresponding length tensor
save_load_cache: save cache elements to a pickle file or load them from a file path
